summary: This is a DSH Web GUI record-and-replay plugin that offers session timeline playback, replay-pack import/export, rerun of recorded sessions, and browser-based screen capture with frame-based skill generation.

classificationSuggestion.reason: This plugin’s primary user-facing purpose is session and workflow automation in DSH Web GUI: replaying recorded conversations in a timeline, exporting/importing replay packages, re-running recorded user messages, and converting browser screen captures into generated skills. The README and package metadata also show it is a dual host/client plugin focused on local session/recording data flows and agent-assisted processing, with validation flags indicating packaging/manifest issues that should be corrected.
